messages.author: b1c85aa4fa464db9
messages.subject: conditional text in title bar
parts:
Is there any way to place conditional text, based on reactive input values, in the title bar of a rendered plot?

E.g.

    fluidRow(
      box(
        width = 7, status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE,
        title = "Title Text"   #   <-- Conditional text here, based in reactive input
        plotOutput(" .... ")

Thank you!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: conditional text in title bar
parts:
I'm guessing you should be able to do something like

title = span(`data-display-if` = condition, title_text)
On Thu, Jul 7, 2016 at 12:27 PM John Williams <john.b....@gmail.com> wrote:

        title = "Title Text"   #   <-- Conditional text here, based in reactive input
        plotOutput(" .... ")

Thank you!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: conditional text in title bar
parts:
Oh, I misunderstood what you meant by "conditional" text--I thought you meant conditionally hidden or shown, not dynamically populated text. For the latter, you can try

title = textOutput("title", inline = TRUE)

Then in the server,

output$title <- renderText({ paste(...) })
